Use case: single-character reconstruction reference for TRELLIS image-to-3D, for a cozy prehistoric Ice Age open-world adventure game. Style: cute Japanese mobile-game chibi 3D character in the style of the attached reference image: a low-poly game model with crisp hand-painted anime textures, soft painted shading on rounded 3D forms (it must read clearly as a 3D model render, not a flat 2D drawing), clean dark-brown painted outlines along clothing edges and hair locks. Super-deformed proportions, about 2.6 heads tall: a very large round head (about 38% of the total height) with a small rounded chin, a small compact body, short limbs, small simple hands with the fingers held together, chunky boots. Anime face: very large glossy eyes with coloured irises, two white catchlights and a dark upper lash line, small simple eyebrows, a tiny nose that is only a small painted mark, a small happy closed-mouth smile, soft pink blush. Hair painted as a few large clean locks with soft shading and one clean highlight band, no individual strands. ONE cheerful young Cro-Magnon woman of the Ice Age (Upper Palaeolithic), light warm-tan skin, dark-brown hair kept above the shoulders (no lock rests on the shoulders, chest or back), never covering the eyes or the face. Cro-Magnon details: clothes of tanned hide and soft fur sewn with visible stitches, a necklace of small pierced white shells with one or two small animal-tooth pendants, two short red-ochre paint stripes on each cheek under the eyes, a red-ochre painted dotted or zigzag band along the hem, a dark leather belt with a small pouch, soft hide boots with cream fur cuffs and cross-laced leather cords. Modest outfit that covers the chest, midriff and hips. POSE: symmetrical A-pose for rigging, standing straight, facing the camera directly, arms straight down and out at about 35-40 degrees from the body with a clear empty gap between each arm and the body and between each hand and the clothes, legs straight and slightly apart with a clear gap between the legs and between the boots, feet flat and pointing forward, empty open hands, no props. Camera: straight-on front view at chest height, orthographic-like, the entire figure from the top of the hair (and any hair ornament or ears) to the boot soles uncropped with generous margin, centered. Lighting: soft even neutral studio light, no harsh highlights, no dark cast shadows on the figure, only a faint contact shadow. Plain uniform off-white background. No text, logo, watermark, scenery, ground plane, base, pedestal, weapon, second figure or multiple views.

Hair: fluffy chin-length bob with rounded bangs and a short braided lock in front of each ear ending at the jaw, each braid tied with a leather cord and a small white bone bead; a small cream feather tucked in above one ear. Amber-brown eyes. Outfit: honey-tan hide dress to just above the knees with cream fur trim at the neckline and hem, a short reddish-brown fur shoulder cape fastened at the front with a small bone toggle.
